nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings with $B$ an $A$-algebra that is integral over $A$, and let $\mathfrak p$ be a maximal ideal of $A$ such that $A$ is $\mathfrak p$-adically complete. Then every maximal ideal $Q$ of $B$ has preimage $\mathfrak p$ under the structure map $A \to B$.
nodes.title: Maximal ideals contract to the maximal ideal of a complete base

nodes.summary: A finite torsion-free local reduced algebra over an adically complete DVR with finite residue field and characteristic zero admits finitely many adically complete DVR points whose kernels intersect to `⊥`, with a common denominator clearing all denominators.
nodes.title: Finitely many DVR points with trivial common kernel

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring that is complete with respect to its maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, $K$ its fraction field, $L$ a finite separable extension of $K$, and $B$ the integral closure of $A$ in $L$. Then there is exactly one prime ideal of $B$ whose preimage under $A \to B$ is $\mathfrak m$.
nodes.title: Exactly one prime lies over the maximal ideal of a complete DVR

nodes.summary: The integral closure of a complete discrete valuation ring in a finite separable extension of its fraction field is finite over the base, is a discrete valuation ring, and is complete for its maximal ideal.
nodes.title: Integral closure of a complete DVR in a separable extension

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring that is complete with respect to its maximal ideal, $K$ its fraction field, and $L$ a finite separable extension of $K$. Let $v$ be a valuation on $L$ with values in a linearly ordered commutative group with zero, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_v = \{x \in L : v(x) \le 1\}$. nodes.title: Valuation rings dominating a complete DVR are integral closures

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be discrete valuation rings, and let $B$ be an $A$-algebra that is finitely generated as an $A$-module and whose structure map $A \to B$ is injective. If $A$ is complete and Hausdorff for the adic topology of its maximal ideal, then $B$ is complete and Hausdorff for the adic topology of its maximal ideal.
nodes.title: Completeness passes to finite extensions of discrete valuation rings

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring that is complete with respect to its maximal ideal, $K$ its fraction field, $L$ a finite separable extension of $K$, and $B$ the integral closure of $A$ in $L$. If $B$ is local (as it always is here), then $B$ is complete with respect to its maximal ideal.
nodes.title: The integral closure of a complete DVR is complete

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring that is complete with respect to its maximal ideal, $K$ its fraction field and $L$ a finite separable extension of $K$. Then the integral closure of $A$ in $L$ is a discrete valuation ring.
nodes.title: The integral closure of a complete DVR is a DVR

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring that is complete with respect to its maximal ideal, $K$ its fraction field and $L$ a finite separable extension of $K$. Then the integral closure of $A$ in $L$ is a local ring.
nodes.title: The integral closure of a complete DVR is local

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be an integral domain and $\mathfrak p$ a maximal ideal of $A$ such that $A$ is $\mathfrak p$-adically complete. If $B$ is an integral domain and an $A$-algebra that is integral over $A$, then $B$ is a local ring.
nodes.title: Domains integral over a complete local domain are local

nodes.title: Valuation rings dominating a complete DVR are finite over it

nodes.summary: A finite algebra over an adically complete Noetherian local ring that is a domain is itself local.
nodes.title: Finite domains over adically complete local rings are local

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
